description: Source code for Lua's string handling, including string table management, hashing, string creation, and cache management.

methods.name: luaS_eqlngstr
methods.description: Checks equality of two long strings based on length and content.

methods.name: luaS_hash
methods.description: Computes hash value for a string with a seed.

methods.name: luaS_hashlongstr
methods.description: Returns hash for a long string, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: luaS_resize
methods.description: Resizes the string table, rehashing if needed.

methods.name: luaS_clearcache
methods.description: Clears the string cache, replacing collectible entries with a fixed string.

methods.name: luaS_init
methods.description: Initializes the string table and cache.

methods.name: luaS_createlngstrobj
methods.description: Creates a new long string object.

methods.name: luaS_remove
methods.description: Removes a string from the string table.

methods.name: luaS_newlstr
methods.description: Creates a new string with explicit length, reusing or creating new.

methods.name: luaS_new
methods.description: Creates or reuses a zero-terminated string, checking cache first.
